persona.title: Activate a role on the closed base
persona.purpose: Activates a conversational role with behaviour that differs per role over the Notebook you already declared sufficient, with no grade or level.
persona.when: the base is closed and you want to use it by talking, not by auditing.
persona.example: An advisor over my sales AI Notebook, to prepare a proposal.
persona.evidence: role confirmed with its own behaviour, answers cited turn by turn, a tag of cited evidence, inference or missing data, and a stated limit when the question leaves the base.
persona.prompt: Step 5 of the workshop, on the base already sufficient. Act as a [TEACHER | ADVISOR | COACH] specialized in this Notebook for [RESULT]: confirm the role and ask what result I want. Roles differ: teacher explains then asks; advisor gives two options with their risk; coach makes me rephrase. Cite every turn or state the limit; distinguish cited evidence, inference and missing data; adjust depth from my previous answer. Do not open a rephrase-and-counterexample cycle and do not grade me: this only activates the role. If my question leaves the base, say so and propose a brief. Do not invent citations or sources.

limits: Ativa um papel consultável; não avalia nem compara desempenho de pessoas: isso cabe a W08
Não desenha a instrução persistente nem os prompts iniciais do Notebook da equipe: isso cabe a W10

traceability.claim: Respostas ancoradas com citações expostas permitem que um papel consultado por várias pessoas cite ou declare limite a cada turno.
A ordem papel, objetivo, parâmetros e fluxo com que se declara o papel da equipe segue o guia público de criação de prompts.
Manter os limites do papel visíveis a qualquer usuário do Notebook e proibir a comparação entre pessoas é política interna do método.
